title: About
content:
HAX art collects the art and media of the HAX project: the Future Traveler mascot, brand assets, posters and materials from talks, browsed with HAX itself.

How you may reuse the art is described in LICENSING.md; some pieces reference other works, and that file says which.

It is made by the HAX project (HAXTheWeb), an open-source effort to let anyone author, remix and publish on the web without needing to learn how the web works. This site is itself a HAX site; its source is on GitHub.

To see how every part of HAX connects, visit hax.cloud. To get in touch, use the Contact page.
